package openfields_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	genclient "open-fields.example/gen/grpc/sample/client"
	genpb "open-fields.example/gen/grpc/sample/pb"
	genserver "open-fields.example/gen/grpc/sample/server"
	gensample "open-fields.example/gen/sample"
)

func TestGeneratedProtobufPreservesOpenMembers(t *testing.T) {
	raw := []byte(`{"integer":9007199254740993123456789,"nested":[null,true,"text"]}`)
	value := &gensample.Question{Message: "Choose", Extensions: map[string]json.RawMessage{"extra": raw, "MESSAGE": json.RawMessage(`"extra value"`)}}
	encoded, err := proto.Marshal(genclient.NewProtoEchoRequest(value))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var request genpb.EchoRequest
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(encoded, &request); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	received := genserver.NewEchoPayload(&request)
	if !bytes.Equal(received.Extensions["MESSAGE"], value.Extensions["MESSAGE"]) || received.Message != value.Message || !bytes.Equal(received.Extensions["extra"], raw) {
		t.Fatalf("request changed: %#v", received)
	}
	encoded, err = proto.Marshal(genserver.NewProtoEchoResponse(received))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var response genpb.EchoResponse
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(encoded, &response); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	returned := genclient.NewEchoResult(&response)
	if !bytes.Equal(returned.Extensions["MESSAGE"], value.Extensions["MESSAGE"]) || returned.Message != value.Message || !bytes.Equal(returned.Extensions["extra"], raw) {
		t.Fatalf("response changed: %#v", returned)
	}
}
